evals.prompt: Audit ViolationsView.swift for accessibility issues, VoiceOver blockers, Dynamic Type clipping, touch target violations, and WCAG contrast hazards.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive accessibility audit report categorizing violations into Critical, High, Medium, and Low with surgical SwiftUI refactors.
expectations: Identifies unlabelled icon Button as a Critical VoiceOver blocker
Identifies rigid .frame(height: 35) on Text as a Critical Dynamic Type clipping hazard
Identifies sub-44pt button (20x20pt) violating Apple HIG and WCAG 2.5.5
Identifies looping .repeatForever() animation lacking accessibilityReduceMotion check
Identifies color-only status indicator violating Differentiate Without Color
Provides surgical BEFORE/AFTER remediation code for all issues

evals.prompt: Audit DynamicTypeViolation.swift for Dynamic Type scaling, layout truncation, and missing @ScaledMetric geometry.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging fixed text container heights and unscaled icon/padding dimensions with ViewThatFits and @ScaledMetric remedies.
expectations: Identifies rigid .frame(height: 40) on headline text as a Dynamic Type clipping risk
Identifies iconSize and padding declared as fixed CGFloat without @ScaledMetric
Recommends @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) for proportional icon and padding scaling
Recommends ViewThatFits or minHeight with fixedSize for vertical expansion

evals.prompt: Audit AccessibleView.swift for accessibility compliance and verify if any violations exist.
evals.expected_output: Audit report confirming 0 accessibility violations, noting adherence to VoiceOver labels, traits, @ScaledMetric, 44pt touch targets, and sensory adaptivity.
expectations: Confirms zero accessibility violations or false positives
Highlights correct usage of @ScaledMetric, accessibilityElement(children: .combine), and minHeight 44pt touch targets
Validates presence of accessibilityReduceMotion, accessibilityReduceTransparency, and accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors
